bio: Neither mount nor monster can hope to defeat Kollodon the Summit. One of the greatest hunters of all the Beastbloods, Kollodon’s Clan has a sacred duty to capture and return monstrous sacrifices to the elemental spirits. It is a duty he performs with stoic dignity… and private glee.
